overview_description.description:
OXUS is a global group of microfinance institutions created in 2005 at the initiative of ACTED, a
leading French international NGO. OXUS currently runs 4 affiliated MFIs in Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan,
Afghanistan and the Democratic Republic of Congo.

OXUS Development Network (ODN), the services company set up by OXUS, runs the group and
provides technical assistance and investment services to the OXUS MFIs and OXUS Holding. ODN is
based in Paris, France. Created in 2007 as a financial holding company, OXUS Holding holds the
equity shares of OXUS institutions and receives the funds raised for the group.

product.name: Small Credit Network Loan (SCGL)
product.description: A group loan product where 4-6 individuals form a network to jointly apply and guarantee each other's loans, primarily serving clients in rural areas with limited access to credit.

product.name: Individual Business Loan (IBL)
product.description: A flexible loan product for experienced entrepreneurs requiring collateral or guarantors, with loan amounts typically ranging from $100 to $50,000.
